title: Group
description: A group stored the way a Cayley diagram stores one: nodes, plus one arrow-map per generator. This schema checks SHAPE only. It cannot express the group laws — that a set of arrows actually forms a group is checked at load time by src/load.ts. A file can satisfy this schema completely and still not be a group.

$schema.description: Path to this schema. ../schema/group.schema.json from groups/, ../../schema/group.schema.json from groups/drafts/.

aliases.description: Other names for the SAME group. V₄ is also the Klein four-group, C₂ × C₂, ℤ/2 × ℤ/2, D₂, and "the rectangle group". Six names for one object; listing them turns a recurring surprise into a lookup.

elements.description: Every member of the group — the nodes of the diagram. Labels only; the mathematics does not care what they are called.

identity.description: Which element is the do-nothing one. Must be a member of `elements`, not a separate thing.

generators.description: Which elements are arrow colours. A generator IS an element; being a generator is a role, not a species. Must be a subset of `elements`.

arrows.description: arrows[generator][from] = to, meaning "from · generator". Every arrow in this project is RIGHT multiplication. One key per generator; each value must cover every element.

notes.description: Free prose. What this group is, where it shows up, anything worth remembering.

source.description: Where the data came from — "hand-authored", a book and page, an import.
